subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): classify model calls as client spans

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally change the legacy-mode model-call telemetry contract from implicit `INTERNAL` to explicit `CLIENT`, accepting that existing trace queries may need to update their kind filters?
rationale: The implementation matches the OpenTelemetry meaning of an outgoing request, but span kind is exported operator-facing telemetry and the branch intentionally changes existing dashboards’ observable classification.

options.title: Accept the CLIENT classification
options.body: Merge the focused fix and treat `CLIENT` as the supported kind for synchronous model-provider calls in every semantic-convention mode.

options.title: Preserve legacy classification
options.body: Keep the current implicit `INTERNAL` legacy-mode behavior if backward compatibility for existing trace queries outweighs semantic consistency.

recommendation.title: Accept the CLIENT classification
recommendation.body: Merge the focused fix and treat `CLIENT` as the supported kind for synchronous model-provider calls in every semantic-convention mode.
